name: Outside Agent
source:
Kollella has no colony, what will she make of herself? A short glimpse of a small life, and the missions that drive it forward.

[From [url=https://dominoclub.itch.io/outside-agent]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
科蕾拉失去了归属的巢群，她将如何走出属于自己的路？惊鸿一瞥间，窥见渺小生命的片刻光景，以及驱使它不断前行的使命。

[摘自[url=https://dominoclub.itch.io/outside-agent]itch.io[/url]]
